chapter.verse: A hang pen mihing lakpana kiteel siampi lianpenpa ahih nakleh Pasian tawh kisai thu ah mite' taangin biakpiak vante leh mawhphel biakpiaknate a luui dinga kiseh ahi hi.
Tua siampi lianpenpa pen amahmah thanemna tampi nei ahih manin thu theilo mite leh a genhak mite' tungah thunem thudam zang thei hi.
Hih thu hangin biakpiakna a luui ding a kulna pen mite' mawhnate hang bek hilo-in amahmah ii mawhnate hang zong ahi hi.
Tua hi a, hih panmun sangpi pen Aaron bangin Pasian' sapkhiatna a ngah uh ahihleh cihloh, ama' thu-a a latawm kuamah om lo uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Khris zong amahmah siampi lianpenpa khat bangin a kisangkhan hilo-in amah a sawlpa in a nuai-a bangin hopihin a seh ahi hi. “Nang pen ka Tapa na hi a, tuni-in nangma' Pa ka suak hi.”
Mun dang khat ah zong hih bangin gen hi: “Nang pen tawntung siampi khat na hi a, Melchizedek guizui na hi hi.”
Jesu a leitung pumpi tawh a om lai-in sihna pan amah a honkhia zopa' kiangah nakpi kikokhia-in khitui naptui tawh thumna leh thungetna luuito a, zahtakna lungsim a neih manin a thunget kidawng hi.
Amah pen Pasian' Tapa hinapi ama' thuak gimna tungtawnin thumanna kisin hi.
Tua bangin a cingtaak a suah khit ciangin ama' thu a mang mi khempeuh' ading tawntung hotkhiatna a phuangkhia hong suak a,
Pasian in Melchizedek guizui siampi lianpenpa dingin minvawh hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-in i gen ding tampi om ahih hangin thulela tel hak na hih manun gentel theih ding haksa hi.

A hang pen note tu lianin hilhcian sya a suahhuai khin hinapi-in Pasian' genkhiat thute tawh kisai kipattah cilna thuciinte hong hilhkik ding mi na kisam lai uh hi. Note antak kisam lo-in nawitui na kisam uh hi.
A hang pen nawitui tawh a kivakte naungek ahih zah khatin dikna tawh kisai thu ah kiva lo uh hi.
Antak ahihleh a picingte' ading hi a, a sia a pha khentel theih nadingin a khuatheihna lungsim uh zat a kisin den mite' ading ahi hi.
